exactArtifactDownloadPages.label: Get x64 live ISO · download page
exactArtifactDownloadPages.reason: The publisher route selects the exact ISO through SourceForge. Mirror links are generated during download; no expiring mirror URL is stored.

exactArtifactDownloadPages.label: Windows x64 download · publisher check
exactArtifactDownloadPages.reason: These are the exact publisher file routes. Sophos applies an export check before delivery; the automated request reached that check rather than a file. Use All downloads / setup if it does not continue.

exactArtifactDownloadPages.label: Get Windows ZIP · 9.9.5
exactArtifactDownloadPages.reason: This opens the exact Standard Edition ZIP on the publisher’s file host and starts its download. The host generates expiring mirror URLs, so a temporary signed address is not saved here.

exactArtifactDownloadPages.label: Windows installer download page
exactArtifactDownloadPages.reason: The publisher generates expiring CDN URLs. The stable official download page obtains a fresh file link; no expiring URL is embedded.

exactArtifactDownloadPages.label: Get Windows portable ZIP · download page
exactArtifactDownloadPages.reason: The exact publisher-hosted ZIP page obtains the file through a mirror; temporary mirror URLs are not saved.

exactArtifactDownloadPages.label: Get x64 rescue image · ISO
exactArtifactDownloadPages.reason: This is the publisher’s exact ISO route. The file host may show its download page before delivering the image; mirror delivery varies by client. No expiring mirror URL is stored.

positiveEvidence.client: Python urllib default user agent; no explicit Accept or cookies

alternateObservation.client: Mozilla/5.0 user agent, Accept */*, Range bytes=0-511

clonezillaMirrorVariation.decision: Keep the exact unsigned publisher ISO route, label it as a download route, and disclose that the host may show its download page before file delivery.

sourceDistinctions.classicOutlookBoundary: Get Help action outlook opens a diagnostic chooser for classic Outlook; connectivity is a separate action. Network and update actions open their specific Microsoft instructions with Windows launch buttons.
